changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.23[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes: posters of new titles[/COLOR]
-New movies and shows that reached Trending before TMDb had their poster kept showing "Poster not available yet" for up to 30 days. The poster now appears as soon as TMDb has it.
-Saved details without a poster are checked again with TMDb after 6 hours. Titles that already have a poster are not touched.
-The quick catalog refresh at startup fills in a missing poster from the TMDb list, also with "Prefer English titles" on. A poster you already have is never replaced.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes: watched without a tracking account[/COLOR]
-Without Trakt or SIMKL, TV shows and seasons had no context menu, so "Mark as watched" never showed up for them. It is back.
-Marking a whole show or season as watched or unwatched now works. Before, it did nothing.
-Shows and seasons get their watched tick: a season counts as watched when all its aired episodes are, and a show when all its seasons are. Specials and episodes not aired yet do not count.
-Resume points were never affected: they are saved on your device with or without an account.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes: security[/COLOR]
-Copy to clipboard no longer goes through the system shell, so copied text can never run as a command. It also works on Linux now.
-The old Sucuri web check is gone: it ran code downloaded from a website and had not worked for years.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-TMDb account: authorizing and revoking the account failed every time before asking TMDb anything. Both work again, and when TMDb does not accept the username or password you are told so.
-Settings > Source Options: "Disable CloudFlare protected providers" is gone. The scrapers it turned off are no longer in luc_kodi, so it did nothing.
-Meteor setup: the wait for the link from your phone or PC stops when Kodi is closing.
-An error while starting playback is now written to kodi.log instead of being skipped.
[COLOR fffdb515]Kodi 21 and Kodi 22[/COLOR]
-Debrid cloud folders, the YouTube menu, trailers and playlists use the video info of Kodi 20 and later. kodi.log no longer gets one "setInfo() is deprecated" warning for every item.
[COLOR fffdb515]Code review[/COLOR]
-The whole add-on was checked with pyflakes, every image with Pillow, and the code against Python 3.13 (Kodi 22). Leftovers that were never used were removed. Nothing changes in what you see.
